verdict.rationale: ReadMe documents isolated branches that hold changes back from the live hub until approved, a Git-based workflow that uses pull requests as the review step, and bi-directional GitHub/GitLab sync. None of the evidence says each pull request automatically gets a shareable preview deployment or URL. Missing for 10: explicit per-PR preview deployments, shareable preview links for reviewers, automatic preview generation tied to Git pull requests, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
